confirmed: The backup commands are unchanged: docker compose stop app worker, pg_dump custom format through the postgres service, tar through a one-off app container on the mounted volume at /var/lib/openlaw/files (compose.yml STORAGE_PATH default and volume).
Stopping app and worker cleanly deletes their runtime_status rows (startRuntimeHeartbeat stop), so the dump carries no live process rows; stale rows older than a day are purged at the next start.

The first API start generates and seals a VAPID pair when none is stored or pinned, so every dump from this build carries a sealed vapid_private_key unless the pair is pinned in .env (index.ts resolveVapid at boot).
The restore commands (pg_restore --exit-on-error --no-owner --no-privileges, tar -xzf through the target app service) are unchanged; the doc engine still holds nothing to back up.
Existing anchors #take-a-coherent-backup and #verify-the-restored-instance are unchanged; upgrade.md and operator-troubleshooting.md link to them.

productBugs.symptom: The operator recovery command calls parseSettings before deleting a section, so it throws 'Advanced settings cannot be decrypted...' when OPENLAW_SECRET_KEY cannot open org_settings.advanced_settings. Once any Advanced value was saved, the column stays non-null even after a reset, and API and worker startup (resolveAdvancedSettings, no catch) refuses on every boot. A lost key therefore leaves no supported way to start the instance.
productBugs.contradicts: TECH-022 (a lost key costs only the sealed credentials; recovery is to paste them again, and a read that threw would fail the pane the recovery happens in) and docs/DEPLOYMENT.md 'If you lose it'

productBugs.symptom: resolveAdvancedSettings and startRuntimeHeartbeat run with no catch before the worker waits for the schema, so a worker that starts while the app migrates from a pre-0139 build can crash on the missing advanced_settings column or runtime_status table and rely on Compose's restart. The file header still says such a worker 'finds no work and waits'. Low impact; the guide now says the restart is expected.
productBugs.contradicts: TECH-005 note in the worker header and compose.yml worker depends_on comment
